subject: Curated workshop rights, brand suite, and AV exceptions
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika@summitworks.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Holloway <ben.h@summitworks.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood – curated workshop + brand suite (draft SOW attached)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited about Redwood running a 90-minute curated workshop at SummitWorks West (Oct 12). I've attached a draft SOW that outlines the workshop rights, a "brand suite" (lounge presence, two registration emails, and two social pushes), and the AV baseline. A couple of flags from our side: we usually require on-site AV to be sourced through the venue (appendix attached), and we only guarantee the on-stage time if the final speaker list is confirmed by Sept 15.

Key asks from our end:
- Confirmation of the workshop title and two speakers by Sep 15
- Lead-gen opt-in wording for our registration form (we can share a template)
- Quick approval of the brand guidelines by Aug 1 so we can build the lanyards and digital assets

I attached: SummitWorks_SOW_v2.pdf and Venue_AV_Rider_Appendix.pdf. Ben (cc'd) is our ops lead and will coordinate AV and load-in windows.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can take the workshop on a curated track (limited to 40 seats) rather than the larger breakout room? That would change staging and AV expectations.

Thanks,
Anika

--
Anika Shah
Partnerships Manager | SummitWorks Events
anika@summitworks.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Anika Shah <anika@summitworks.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood – curated workshop + brand suite (draft SOW attached)

Hi Anika — thanks for the SOW and the clear heads-up. Redwood is interested in the curated track; the intimacy actually fits our goals for a technical, hands-on session. A few quick notes from product/marketing ops: 

1) Speakers: we can commit to two leads by Sept 7 instead of Sept 15 — can you confirm that earlier deadline preserves the on-stage time?
2) AV exceptions: we need one wired ethernet drop and permission to use a local display (we bring a Mac mini). If the venue insists on sourcing everything through their AV house, please note Redwood requires a short-term network isolation (private VLAN) for demo traffic. Is that feasible?
3) Brand suite: we will provide lanyard artwork and a one-line sponsor blurb. We will not provide social copy beyond two short posts. Please include an "approved by Redwood" checkpoint in the timeline (we'd prefer a 48-hour review window).

Attaching our brand guide and a short speaker requirements checklist. Can you ask Ben to confirm load-in window (we prefer 60-75 minutes for setup)? Also, we'd like the lead-gen opt-in to include an option to join a waitlist for an upcoming beta.

If these are acceptable, we'll get legal to review the SOW and return redlines the week of May 3.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | (415) 555-0133

Attachment: Redwood_Brand_Guidelines_2027.zip

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood – curated workshop + brand suite (draft SOW attached)

Lauren — looping in ops and creative on a couple of items before we send to Legal. Quick internal points: 

- AV/network: Ops (Aditya) — can you confirm whether the private VLAN is a hard no for the venue? If we can't get VLAN, can we do a small cellular fallback (hotspot pool) for demos?
- Lead capture: Marketing (Marissa) — we need to confirm the exact opt-in language and whether showing a QR code at the session is allowed. SummitWorks sometimes restricts registration-form custom fields.
- Logo usage: Creative prefers one hero logo on the summit home page and a secondary lockup on the session page; we should specify exact color usage and file formats in the SOW (PNG/SVG).

I'll draft a short internal checklist and send you before EOD so Legal has the full ask for redlines.

-Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Field Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Ben Holloway <ben.h@summitworks.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Anika Shah <anika@summitworks.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Revised SOW and AV appendix (requested updates)

Hi Lauren / Kim,

Thanks for the quick replies and the brand guide. Attached is an updated SOW with three changes per your notes:
- speaker confirmation deadline moved to Sept 7
- explicit allowance for one vendor-supplied wired ethernet drop and a private VLAN request noted as "subject to venue approval" (we've added a clause that if venue denies VLAN, SummitWorks will provide a wired-to-cellular bridge at no additional sponsor cost)
- added a short section on logo file formats and a 48-hour creative approval checkpoint

Load-in window: 13:00–14:15 on Oct 12 (we can extend to 14:30 if needed; will confirm footprint).

I've also attached Venue_AV_Rider_Appendix.pdf with the standard house-rider. If these terms look good, I can issue a DocuSign request.

Best,
Ben

Attachment: SummitWorks_SOW_v2.pdf

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Ben Holloway <ben.h@summitworks.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised SOW and AV appendix (requested updates)

Ben — that updated SOW addresses everything we needed. Two final items before DocuSign: 

1) Can SummitWorks add a short clause that our workshop attendee list (opted-in records only) will be provided within 72 hours post-event in CSV format with column headers noted? We need the attendee emails and company names for follow-up.
2) Please confirm that the "wired-to-cellular bridge" will be tested during load-in and that SummitWorks will provide signal strength for the session room at least 48 hours prior.

If both are confirmed, please send the DocuSign and we'll route to Legal + Revenue Ops for signature. Thanks — looking forward to a high-quality session.

Regards,
Lauren
